title: Standing reset
intro: Stand up, take a little space and move. A hand on the desk is always fine if you want some support.

moves.name: Stand tall
steps: Stand with your feet about hip width apart.
Let your arms hang loose and your shoulders drop.
Take a few slow, easy breaths.

moves.name: Reach up
steps: Breathe in and sweep your arms up and out to the sides.
Reach toward the ceiling, only as far as is comfortable.
Breathe out and lower them slowly.

moves.name: Side lean
steps: Reach one arm up and over, leaning gently to the other side.
Keep both feet planted.
Come back to upright, then switch sides.

moves.name: Hip circles
steps: Place your hands on your hips.
Draw slow, wide circles with your hips.
Switch direction halfway through.

moves.name: Heel raises
steps: Hold the desk or a chair back if you like.
Rise slowly onto your toes, then lower your heels back down.
Keep the pace calm.

moves.name: Shoulder rolls
steps: Let your arms hang loose.
Roll your shoulders back and down in slow circles.
Switch to rolling forward halfway through.

moves.name: Slow walk on the spot
steps: Lift each foot a little and set it down softly.
Swing your arms loosely.
Keep it relaxed rather than quick.

closing: That is the reset. Notice how you feel standing there, then carry on when you are ready.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
